name: morphazoid
description: Morphazoid - geometric instruments for shape, lattice, spatial forms, and live audio loops.

scripts.analyze:architecture: npm run analyze:duplicates && npm run analyze:dependencies
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run check:xyflow && npm run check:wax-dist
scripts.test:browser:smoke: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/site-smoke.spec.mjs
scripts.test:browser:midi: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/midi-contract.spec.mjs
scripts.test:browser:audio: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/audio-contract.spec.mjs
scripts.test:browser:v2-pilot: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/v2-geometry-preservation.spec.mjs --workers=1
scripts.test:browser:v2-rollout: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/v2-geometry-preservation.spec.mjs e2e/v2-canvas-rollout.spec.mjs --workers=1
scripts.test:browser:v2-uniformity: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/v2-canvas-uniformity.spec.mjs --workers=1
scripts.test:browser:v2-tract: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/v2-tract-preservation.spec.mjs e2e/v2-tract-rendering.spec.mjs --workers=1
scripts.test:browser:v2-layout: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/v2-source-layout.spec.mjs --workers=1
scripts.test:browser:v2-site: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/v2-site-bootstrap.spec.mjs e2e/shared-consistency.spec.mjs --workers=1
scripts.test:refactor:fast: node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/canvas-sizing*.test.mjs tests/audio.test.mjs tests/synth-processor.test.mjs tests/audio-output-manager.test.mjs tests/audio-transport-contract.test.mjs tests/architecture-tooling.test.mjs tests/tract-geometry.test.mjs tests/tract-rendering.test.mjs tests/runtime-source-check.test.mjs tests/instrument-registry.test.mjs tests/release-manifest.test.mjs tests/source-layout.test.mjs
scripts.test:refactor:batch: npm run test:refactor:fast && npm run check:xyflow && npm run check:wax-dist && npm run test:browser:v2-uniformity && npm run test:browser:v2-rollout && npm run test:browser:v2-tract && npm run test:browser:v2-site && npm run test:browser:v2-layout && npm run test:browser:audio && npm run verify
scripts.test:browser:audit: npm run build:xyflow && playwright test e2e/control-inventory.spec.mjs e2e/shared-consistency.spec.mjs e2e/responsive.spec.mjs e2e/accessibility.spec.mjs e2e/shared-legacy-control-geometry.spec.mjs
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build:site && npm run build:storybook -- --output-dir dist/storybook
